The animal with distinctive black and white stripes is the zebra.

Semantic role analysis of the text: "The firefighter raced into the burning building to rescue the trapped occupants, demonstrating true heroism."

Main Verb: raced

- The firefighter: Agent (the entity performing the action of racing)
- into the burning building: Location/Goal (the direction or destination of the racing)
- to rescue the trapped occupants: Purpose (the reason for the action)
  - the trapped occupants: Patient/Theme (the entity being rescued within the purpose clause)
- demonstrating true heroism: Manner/Result (a concurrent action or result of the main verb)
  - true heroism: Theme (the content of the demonstration)
